title: CV Tracking Stats
headline_insight: The computer-vision tracker has produced 17,254 feature rows across 241 games and 252 players, a volume readout only.
what_it_means: This is a coverage count of the tracking layer, not an accuracy claim: 29 distinct feature names, a median of 56 tracked rows per game, and a median of 2 distinct players tracked per game. No multi-object-tracking quality metric is benchmarked.
how_to_read: Read it as counts of rows, games and players plus per-game distributions; the top-tracked list is player ids by row count.
why_it_matters: It states the scale of what the tracking pipeline has emitted, useful for scope without overclaiming.
caveat: Volume and coverage stats only, with no accuracy or quality claims (MOT metrics are unbenchmarked, see JOB_EVIDENCE_PACKET s4). There is no season breakdown because the box-score join on (game_id, player_id) returns 0 matching rows.
